Card Q&A.q: If both blue and green cards are in this card’s digivolution cards, do I activate both parts of this card’s [When Attacking] effect?
If a single blue and green multicolor card is in this card’s digivolution cards, do I activate both parts of this card’s [When Attacking] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 10000 DP or less to its owner's hand.

[When Attacking][Once Per Turn] If a blue card is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, unsuspend 1 of your Digimon. If a green card is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
